title: DYHOO Wide Ceramic Flat Iron, Pink

comparisons.notes: Same DYHOO wide ceramic straightener in blush pink: 4.3 x 2.2 in floating ceramic plates, 11 settings 270-450F, 45-min auto shutoff; sale price $49.99 (reg $79.99)

writeup: DYHOO's wide ceramic flat iron in pink is $16.99 on Woot, compared with $49.99 on DYHOO's own shop. It has extra-wide 4.3 by 2.2 inch floating ceramic plates, 11 heat settings from 270F to 450F with a digital display, negative-ion output and a 45-minute auto shutoff. Woot limits it to 3 per customer.
